T: Raised in the jungle. Fed like a king.
D: A man raised by gorillas meets an English explorer's daughter and has to choose between two worlds.
P: Serve the tea when Jane sets out her tea service in the jungle.
S: the proper English tea Jane brings to the jungle

Poached chicken in a mild curried mayo with mango chutney, sultanas and toasted almonds, on soft white bread cut into neat crustless fingers. Poach 2 chicken breasts for 15 minutes, cool and dice finely. Mix 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp mango chutney, 1 tsp mild curry powder, a squeeze of lemon, 30g sultanas and 30g toasted flaked almonds. Fold through the chicken with chopped coriander. Butter 12 slices of white bread, fill 6 sandwiches with a handful of baby spinach each, cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.

Spiced roasted chickpeas and cashews with curry powder and honey, roasted at 180C for 25 minutes until crunchy, tipped out messily on a board.
M: Chicken thigh curry in a tomato and coconut milk sauce
Chicken thighs cooked with onion, ginger, garlic and curry spices, tomato and coconut milk, simmered 40 minutes, with rice and mango chutney.

Caught off the waterfall below the treehouse

Firm white fish simmered in coconut milk with tomato, ginger, chilli and spinach, over rice with lime. Soften the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli in the oil. Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer. Meanwhile steam the rice. Add the fish and simmer gently until just cooked. Stir through the spinach and lime juice and serve over rice.
700g firm white fish fillets, in chunks@Seafood
W: Thick banana slices fried in light batter, rolled in cinnamon sugar, honey drizzle
Ripe bananas in thick slices dipped in a light batter of flour and sparkling water, fried at 180C until puffed, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with honey.
K: Black iced tea sweetened with peach and honey syrup

Black tea brewed strong and cooled, stirred with a fresh peach and honey syrup and lemon, poured over ice with peach slices and mint. Steep 4 black tea bags in 1 litre boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 80g honey and 100ml water for 5 minutes, crush and strain. Stir the syrup and the juice of a lemon into the tea and chill. Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and a sprig of mint.

s.note: Banana, mango, pineapple and papaya with passionfruit and lime
s.how: Cut 3 bananas, 2 mangoes, a quarter pineapple and half a papaya into big chunks. Pile on banana leaves with the pulp of 2 passionfruit, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of chilli salt.

s.note: Crunchy roasted chickpeas and cashews with curry powder and honey
s.how: Drain and dry 2 tins chickpeas. Toss with 150g cashews, 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp curry powder and 1 tbsp honey. Roast at 180C for 25 minutes until crunchy and tip out messily on a board.

m.note: Chicken thigh curry in a tomato and coconut milk sauce
m.how: Soften an onion with ginger, garlic and 2 tbsp curry powder. Add 1kg diced chicken thighs, a tin of tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 40 minutes. Serve with 300g basmati rice and mango chutney.

w.note: Thick banana slices fried in light batter, rolled in cinnamon sugar, honey drizzle
w.how: Whisk 150g flour with 200ml sparkling water. Dip thick slices of 4 bananas and fry at 180C until puffed. Roll in 80g sugar with cinnamon and drizzle with honey.

d.note: Black iced tea sweetened with peach and honey syrup
d.how: Steep 4 black tea bags in 1 litre boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 80g honey and 100ml water for 5 minutes, crush and strain. Stir the syrup and the juice of a lemon into the tea and chill. Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and a sprig of mint.
